label: Lawn Care & Landscaping (Forest Emerald)
description: Cinematic dark forest-green theme with vibrant lime/grass-green accents. Perfect for lawn maintenance, landscaping, sod installation, and hardscaping. Uses the cozy editorial Chalet style with rounded corners and card borders.
notes: colorFamily 'emerald' replaces Tailwind's cool 'slate-*' background and border classes with rich organic 'emerald-*' classes across all elements.
Style 'chalet' uses cozy serif-like headlines, soft cream surfaces (#FAF9F5), and rounded details.
Services.astro and ServicesChalet should feature high-quality lawn care images: mowing lines, sod laying, clean hedges, and patio stones.
Configure CompareSlider with high-contrast before/after items: e.g. overgrown weed yard vs. clean manicured lawn, or raw dirt vs. freshly rolled green sod.
HeroChalet requires a background image (bgImage) of a beautiful landscaped yard with sharp grass lines, and a signature bottom mountain-ridge clip shape.
Keep headlines highly active: use strong words like 'transform', 'manicure', 'craft', and 'prune' instead of generic service lists.
